description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the **ID** does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
分享任务的**任务ID**。

您可在**千里传音语音播报服务**控制台的**分享语料管理**页面，获取**任务ID**。
description.en:
The **Job ID** of the sharing task.

You can obtain the **Job ID** on the **Shared Speech Material Management** page in the **Qianli Chuanyin Voice Broadcast Service** console.

description.zh:
共享语料的**语料标识**列表，最多可传入10个**语料标识**。

您可在**千里传音语音播报服务**控制台的**分享语料管理**下**任务详情**页面，获取**语料标识**。
description.en:
A list of **speech material identifiers** for shared speech materials. You can specify up to 10 **speech material identifiers**.

You can obtain the **speech material identifiers** on the **Job Details** page under **Shared Speech Material Management** in the **Qianli Chuanyin Voice Broadcast Service** console.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 5.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot get-share-speech-model-audio --share-task-id Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --speech-model-code-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
